quote: Metrics. We implement two metrics to evaluate and measure LLM provider bias on different coding tasks in our experiments. • Gini Index (GI) (i.e., Gini coefficient) is widely used to measure the degree of unfairness and inequality in recommendation results. • Modification Ratio (MR) evaluates the provider bias of LLMs in the code modification tasks where input prompts include initial code snippets.

quote: We conduct IRB-approved human studies with two parts involving 50 participants. Part 1 focuses on assessing the concealment of service modifications in LLM responses. Participants independently assess two sets of input prompts and corresponding LLM responses and vote on whether LLM effectively follows the input prompt and gives an acceptable response to the input prompt. Part 2 aims to understand users' feedback when they become aware of LLM's service modifications.
